query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as duplicate_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    p1.id as id1,
    p2.id as id2
  FROM priceHistory p1
  JOIN priceHistory p2 ON (
    p1.id < p2.id
    AND p1.cardId = p2.cardId
    AND p1.source = p2.source
    AND p1.source = 'snkrdunk'
    AND p1.jpyPrice = p2.jpyPrice
    AND COALESCE(p1.grade, '') = COALESCE(p2.grade, '')
    AND p1.sourcePosition = p2.sourcePosition
    AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 72
  )
) as dupes;
